columns.comment: Credit-system obligor id (CRD-nnnnnn) the statements were spread under; a golden client can have two obligor records (duplicate credit files), each with its own statements.
columns.name: obligor_id

columns.comment: Surrogate key of the dim_client version valid on this row's date (SCD2 as-was join, D11); join to gold.dim_client.golden_client_sk for the client attributes at that time.
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Durable golden client id from entity resolution (GC-nnnnnn), stable across ER runs and SCD2 versions; one golden client = one resolved legal entity.

columns.comment: Client group (global parent group) id from the Tokyo HO group master (SYN-G-nnnn); join to gold.dim_client_group.
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: Client's own fiscal year of the statement (2023-2025); FY2025 = the year ending Dec-2025 or Mar-2026 depending on the client's year-end.
columns.name: fiscal_year

columns.comment: Statement fiscal year label, e.g. FY2025.
columns.name: fiscal_year_label

columns.comment: Balance-sheet date / end of the client's fiscal year (31 Dec or 31 Mar); join to gold.dim_date.
columns.name: fiscal_year_end_date

columns.comment: Month of the client's fiscal year-end: 12 (December) or 3 (March).
columns.name: fye_month

columns.comment: Statement: P&L, Balance Sheet or Cash Flow.
columns.name: statement_type

columns.comment: Standard spread line, e.g. Revenue, COGS, EBITDA, EBIT, Interest Expense, Net Income, Cash, Receivables, Inventory, Payables, Total Assets, Short-Term Debt, Long-Term Debt, Total Debt, Net Debt (derived), Equity, Cash Flow from Operations, Capex, Free Cash Flow, Dividends Paid.

columns.name: line_order

columns.name: is_cost_or_outflow

columns.comment: True for subtotal lines (Gross Profit, EBITDA, EBIT, Pre-Tax Profit, Net Income, Total Current Assets, Total Assets, Total Debt, Net Debt, Free Cash Flow).
columns.name: is_subtotal

columns.name: is_derived_line

columns.comment: Line amount in USD (statement-year flow or year-end balance); costs positive; Free Cash Flow and Net Debt can be negative.
columns.name: amount_usd

columns.name: amount_lcy

columns.comment: ISO currency of the statements (local reporting currency).

columns.comment: Same line in the previous fiscal year, USD (null for FY2023, the first spread year).
columns.name: prior_year_amount_usd

columns.comment: Same line in the previous fiscal year, local currency (null for FY2023).
columns.name: prior_year_amount_lcy

columns.comment: Spreading task id (SPR-...) of the obligor and fiscal year; see fact_credit_review_workflow.
columns.name: spreading_task_id

columns.comment: Spreading task status: Checked, In Progress or Received - Not Started.
columns.name: spreading_status

columns.comment: Date the bank received the statements for spreading.
columns.name: statement_received_date

columns.comment: Credit analyst (employee_id) who spreads the statements; join to gold.dim_employee.
columns.name: spreading_analyst_id

columns.comment: Second-line checker (employee_id) who checked the spread; null until checked.
columns.name: spreading_checker_id

comment: Spread financial statements of credit clients in long format (credit memo pack, brief 5.3): one row per credit obligor record x fiscal year x statement line (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) for FY2023-FY2025, in USD and local currency, with the prior-year amount, YoY growth, audit basis and the spreading task (analyst, checker, status). Each client keeps its own fiscal year-end (December or March, D17). A derived Net Debt line (Total Debt - Cash) is included (is_derived_line). Costs and outflows (COGS, operating expenses, D&A, interest expense, tax, capex, dividends paid) are stored as positive amounts. Amounts are annual flows (P&L, cash flow) or year-end balances (balance sheet): never add different line items or balance-sheet years together. FY2025 statements still being spread have is_spread = false. Grain: one row per credit obligor x fiscal year x statement line item.
